channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Ford fends off Hyundai to retain No. 3 U.S. sales position in third quarter
item.description: Ford on Friday reported a year-over-year sales decline of 6.6% during the third quarter to 507,395 light-duty vehicles.

item.title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why
item.description: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis.

item.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
item.description: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.

item.title: Stocks rise after soft jobs data; Nasdaq hits record led by Nvidia: Live updates
item.description: The Dow was headed for a losing week.

item.title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.

item.title: Bitcoin just formed a 'golden cross' pattern. The crypto is setting up for a big fourth quarter
item.description: When looking for best ideas for the fourth quarter nothing jumped off the charts to me — literally — like bitcoin.

item.title: Why Lilly and Novo are betting on amylin to power a new wave of obesity drugs after GLP-1s
item.description: Eli Lilly and Novo are developing new amylin drugs that serve as another biological lever to pull in treating obesity and diabetes.

item.title: American starts letting customers mix cash and miles for tickets
item.description: American is joining other carriers that allow customers to book with a combination of points and miles.

item.title: David Ellison says combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery will be named Skydance
item.description: It's a full-circle moment for a company that has undergone two major acquisitions within the last 18 months.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher despite weaker-than-expected jobs report
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields rose despite a September jobs report came in much weaker than expected.

item.title: Treasury Sec. Bessent, IRS crack down on ETF strategy the wealthy are using to avoid capital gains taxes
item.description: The IRS and Treasury issued a warning this week on an ETF strategy wealthy investors have been using to shield capital gains income from taxes.

item.title: A Brexit reversal is on the table 10 years on from the vote that changed Britain. Here’s what’s at stake
item.description: Britain voted to leave the European Union in 2016.

item.title: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
item.description: Odds tumbled after a jobs report showed a soft labor market, leading more traders to lower the the chances of a fed funds rate increase this month.

item.title: The sector in the cross hairs of the bond sell-off looks poised for a bounce, says Mike Khouw
item.description: An interesting tug of war is happening in one of the market's hottest sectors: utilities.

item.title: Nike shares tumble after weak revenue outlook and layoff plans underway
item.description: Nike's shares dropped for a second straight day of declines after it reported falling revenue and plans to lay off staff.

item.title: This hyperscaler made Goldman Sachs’ list of top picks for October

item.title: Anthropic warns government attitudes may hurt customer ties, IPO prospectus shows: Reuters
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei met President Donald Trump last Sunday for dinner as ‌calls for greater regulation of AI have grown.

item.title: Oil prices fall on report of potential diesel, crude stock release; Brent back below $100
item.description: It comes after Reuters reported that EU nations were discussing a proposal to release diesel reserves following pressure from the Trump administration.

item.title: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
item.description: Banks are fueling a hiring surge for AI engineers who are good at "agent orchestration" — the ability to coordinate teams of specialized agents.

item.title: Burger King is betting on local franchisees to fuel its U.S. comeback
item.description: Burger King is refranchising hundreds of its company-owned restaurants as part of its turnaround, while prioritizing local operators.

item.title: Nvidia breaks through to new record highs. Plus, more good news for Boeing
item.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

item.title: Is debt consolidation a good idea? Here’s how to know, plus where to find a loan
item.description: Debt consolidation may be a good fit if you have multiple high-interest debts, qualify for lower rates and can manage the new monthly payment.

item.title: United Airlines gets aggressive in battle for top Delta, American flyers
item.description: United Airlines launched an aggressive status match program for Delta and American's top frequent flyer elites.

item.title: U.S. to send third carrier group to Mideast as Trump warns of new Iran strikes

item.title: Democratic Texas AG candidate vows to probe Deloitte's role in voter registration delay

item.title: Trump wants South Korea in on Alaska LNG. Here’s why Seoul is cautious
item.description: South Korea remains cautious on Alaska LNG amid concerns over its high costs and commercial risks.

item.title: Big Pharma’s China deal spree grows with latest tie-up worth up to $7.8 billion
item.description: Western biopharma companies are increasingly turning to China to source innovation, as pharma's dreaded "patent cliff" draws closer.

item.title: Trump could target three Fed governors. Removing them may be harder than it looks

item.title: New York City's 'click to cancel' subscription rule takes effect, joining states with similar laws
item.description: The Big Apple joins a growing number of jurisdictions adopting 'click to cancel' rules as the future of a federal standard remains unsettled.
